title: NYC dates move fast. Houston moves at traffic speed.
old_caption:
Is your dating pace fast lunch dates or slow drives across town?
Fast or slow doesn't matter. Find a pace you can share.

title: Opposite signs aren't doomed. They're balanced.
old_caption:
Are you and your opposite sign doomed?
Libra says no. Sitting across the wheel just means you balance each other.

title: You don't owe your whole past on date one.
old_caption:
Getting asked about every ex on a first date?
Share at the pace trust grows. Your story is yours to tell slowly.

title: Checking their phone is never okay.
old_caption:
Ever been tempted to look at their phone?
Taurus says hands off. If trust feels shaky, talk about it out loud.

title: Pisces aren't too soft. Soft is strong.
old_caption:
Told you're too sensitive for your own good?
Gentleness takes courage, and so does saying no. Soft and strong can be both.

title: Planning a date is the most romantic thing.
old_caption:
Is a planned date more romantic than a spontaneous one?
Capricorn and Sagittarius find out effort is the real romance, either way.

title: Your rising sign is who shows up on the first date.
old_caption:
Is the person on the first date the real them?
The rising sign is just the first impression. Stay for the rest of the book.

title: Sagittarius isn't scared of commitment.
old_caption:
Think a Sagittarius can't commit?
Freedom and commitment can live together. Talk about both.

title: Single at 30 is a flex.
old_caption:
Single at 30 and the aunties keep asking when?
Single is a whole life, not a waiting room. You're not behind.

title: Soft launches are fine. Hard launch when sure.
old_caption:
Soft launch or hard launch?
Post when you're both ready. Privacy isn't secrecy. Your love, your timeline.
